units.zh: 夫在天成象，聖人是觀，日月五星，象之著者，變常舛度，徵咎隨焉。
units.en: Heaven sets signs in the sky, and the sage is the one who reads them; the sun, moon, and five planets are the clearest of those signs—when the usual order shifts and celestial measures go wrong, omens of calamity follow in their wake.
units.literal: As for Heaven forming signs on high, the sage is one who observes them; the sun, moon, and five stars are the prominent among such signs—when constancy changes and degrees go awry, tokens of blame and misfortune follow.

units.zh: 然則明晦暈蝕，疾餘犯守，飛流欻起，彗孛不恒，或皇靈降臨，示譴以戒下，或王化有虧，感達於天路。
units.en: Whether in brightness or dimness, halos or eclipses, swift planetary crossings or prolonged station-keeping, sudden meteors or unpredictable comets—sometimes the imperial spirit descends to warn the realm below, and sometimes defects in royal governance reach heaven's road.
units.literal: Thus whether bright or dark, halos or eclipses, swift trespass and lingering occupancy, meteor flashes suddenly rising, or comets and broom-stars not constant—sometimes the imperial numen descends, displaying reprimand to warn those below, or sometimes royal transformation is impaired and the response reaches the road of Heaven.

units.zh: 易稱「天垂象，見吉凶」，「觀乎天文，以察時變」；
units.en: The Book of Changes says, "Heaven displays signs revealing fortune and misfortune," and "Look to the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the times";
units.literal: The Changes says, "Heaven displays signs by which fortune and misfortune may be seen," and "Observe the patterns of heaven to discern the changes of the times";

units.zh: 書曰「曆象日月星辰，敬授民時」。
units.en: The Book of Documents says, "Mark out the sun, moon, stars, and constellations, and reverently give the people their seasons."
units.literal: The Documents says, "Calculate and image the sun, moon, stars, and constellations, and reverently bestow the seasons upon the people."

units.zh: 是故有國有家者之所祗畏也。
units.en: This is why rulers of states and clans treat it with reverent awe.
units.literal: Therefore this is what those who possess a state or a clan hold in reverent awe.

units.zh: 百王興廢之驗，萬國禍福之來，兆勤雖微，罔不必至，著於前載，不可得而備舉也。
units.en: The rise and fall of dynasties and the fortune or ruin of nations—even the faintest omen is never empty; the former records are full of them, and no complete list could be given.
units.literal: The proofs of the rise and fall of the hundred kings, the coming of fortune and misfortune to the myriad states—though the portents be slight and subtle, none fail to arrive; recorded in former annals, they cannot all be enumerated.

units.zh: 班史以日暈五星之屬列天文志，薄蝕彗孛之比入五行說。
units.en: Ban Gu's History put solar halos and the five planets in the Astronomical Treatise, but eclipses, comets, and similar phenomena in the discourse on the Five Phases.
units.literal: Ban's History placed solar halos and the five stars and their kind in the Treatise on Astronomy, while thin eclipses, comets, and broom-stars and the like were entered into the discourse on the Five Phases.

units.zh: 七曜一也，而分為二志，故陸機云學者所疑也。
units.en: The seven luminaries are one class of phenomena, yet Ban split them across two treatises—hence Lu Ji's remark that scholars have long found this puzzling.
units.literal: The seven luminaries are one category, yet they were divided into two treatises; hence Lu Ji said that scholars have doubts about this.

units.zh: 今以在天諸異咸入天象，其應徵符合，隨而條載，無所顯驗則闕之云。
units.en: Here all heavenly anomalies are gathered in this Celestial Phenomena treatise; when earthly events confirm the omen, they are recorded in sequence, and where no verification appears, the entry is left blank.
units.literal: Now all celestial anomalies in the heavens are gathered into Celestial Phenomena; where there are corresponding proofs, they are entered item by item as they occur, and where there is no manifest verification, that is omitted.

units.zh: 太祖天興五年八月，天鳴。
units.en: In the eighth month of Tianxing 5, during the reign of Emperor Daowu, the sky roared.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Tianxing under Emperor Taizu, the sky sounded.

units.zh: 六年九月，天鳴。
units.en: In the ninth month of year 6, the sky roared again.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year, the sky sounded.

units.zh: 皇始二年十月壬辰，日暈，有佩璚。
units.en: In the tenth month of Huangshi 2, on renchen day, a solar halo appeared with pendant ornaments.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Huangshi, on the day renchen, there was a solar halo with pendant jades.

units.zh: 占曰「兵起」。
units.en: The omen reads: "War will break out."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies will rise."

units.zh: 天興元年九月，烏丸張超收合亡命，聚黨三千餘家，據勃海之南皮，自號征東大將軍、烏丸王，鈔掠諸郡。
units.en: In the ninth month of Tianxing 1, the Wuhuan leader Zhang Chao rallied fugitives into a force of more than three thousand households, seized Nanpi in Bohai, proclaimed himself Grand General Who Conquers the East and King of the Wuhuan, and plundered the surrounding commanderies.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Tianxing, the Wuhuan Zhang Chao gathered fugitives, assembling a band of more than three thousand households, seized Nanpi in Bohai, styled himself Grand General Who Conquers the East and King of the Wuhuan, and raided the commanderies.

units.zh: 詔將軍庾岳討之。
units.en: The court ordered General Yu Yue to suppress him.
units.literal: An edict ordered General Yu Yue to attack him.

units.zh: 天興三年六月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month of Tianxing 3, on the gengchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Tianxing, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「外國侵，土地分」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Foreign powers will invade and territory will be lost."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Foreign states invade; territory is divided."

units.zh: 五年五月，姚興遣其弟義陽公平率眾四萬來侵平陽，乾壁為平所陷。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 5, Yao Xing sent his brother Yao Ping, Prince of Yiyang, with forty thousand troops against Pingyang; Ganbi fell to Ping's forces.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, Yao Xing sent his younger brother, Prince of Yiyang Yao Ping, leading forty thousand men to invade Pingyang; Ganbi was taken by Ping.

units.zh: 六年四月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fourth month of year 6, on the guisi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year, on the first day guisi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「兵稍出」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Troops will soon take the field."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies will gradually go forth."

units.zh: 十月，太祖詔將軍伊謂率騎二萬北襲高車，大破之。
units.en: In the tenth month, Emperor Daowu ordered General Yi Wei north with twenty thousand cavalry against the Gaoche and routed them utterly.
units.literal: In the tenth month, Emperor Taizu ordered General Yi Wei to lead twenty thousand horsemen north to strike the Gaoche and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 天賜五年七月戊戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month of Tianci 5, on the wuxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Tianci, on the first day wuxu, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「后死」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The empress will die."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The empress dies."

units.zh: 六年七月，夫人劉氏薨，後諡為宣穆皇后。
units.en: In the seventh month of year 6, Lady Liu died; she was later posthumously honored as Empress Xuanmu.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Lady Liu passed away; later she was given the posthumous title Empress Xuanmu.

units.zh: 太宗神瑞二年八月庚辰晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eighth month of Shenrui 2, during the reign of Emperor Mingyuan, on gengchen day, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Shenrui under Emperor Taizong, on the day gengchen, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 世祖始光四年六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month of Shiguang 4, during the reign of Emperor Taiwu, on the guimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Shiguang under Emperor Shizu, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「諸侯非其人」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The wrong men hold power among the feudatories."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The feudal lords are not the right men."

units.zh: 神䴥元年二月，司空奚斤、監軍侍御史安頡討赫連昌，擒之於安定。
units.en: In the second month of Shenlu 1, Minister of Works Xi Jin and Supervising Army Attendant Censor An Xie campaigned against Helian Chang and took him prisoner at Anding.
units.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shenlu, Minister of Works Xi Jin and Supervising Army Attendant Censor An Xie attacked Helian Chang and captured him at Anding.

units.zh: 其餘眾立昌弟定為主，走還平涼，斤追之，為定所擒。
units.en: The survivors set up Chang's brother Ding as their leader and withdrew to Pingliang; Xi Jin pursued them but was captured by Ding.
units.literal: The remaining host installed Chang's younger brother Ding as ruler, fled back to Pingliang, and Jin pursued them but was captured by Ding.

units.zh: 將軍丘堆棄甲與守將高涼王禮東走蒲坂，世祖怒，斬堆。
units.en: General Qiu Dui abandoned his armor and fled east to Puban with the garrison commander, Prince Li of Gaoliang; Emperor Taiwu was furious and had Dui executed.
units.literal: General Qiu Dui cast off his armor and, with the defending commander Prince of Gaoliang Li, fled east to Puban; Emperor Shizu was enraged and executed Dui.

units.zh: 神䴥元年十一月乙未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Shenlu 1, on the yiwei new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Shenlu, on the first day yiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 太延元年正月己未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of Taiyan 1, on the jiwei new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Taiyan, on the first day jiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 四年十一月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 4, on the dingmao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on the first day dingmao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 太平真君元年四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fourth month of Taiping Zhenjun 1, on the wuwu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Taiping Zhenjun, on the first day wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年八月甲戌晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eighth month of year 3, on jiaxu day, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, on the day jiaxu, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 六年六月戊子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 6, on the wuzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, on the first day wuzi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有九族夷滅」。
units.en: The omen reads: "An entire clan will be wiped out."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The nine degrees of kin will be exterminated to the roots."

units.zh: 七年正月戊辰，世祖車駕次東雍州。
units.en: In the first month of year 7, on wuchen day, Emperor Taiwu's entourage encamped in Eastern Yong Province.
units.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, on the day wuchen, Emperor Shizu's imperial carriage halted at Eastern Yong Province.

units.zh: 庚午，圍薛永宗營壘。
units.en: On gengwu day he besieged Xue Yongzong's camp.
units.literal: On gengwu he besieged Xue Yongzong's fortified camp.

units.zh: 永宗出戰，大敗，六軍乘之，永宗眾潰，斬永宗，男女無少長皆赴汾水而死。
units.en: Yongzong gave battle and was routed; the Six Armies pressed the attack, his forces broke, and he was beheaded; men and women of every age threw themselves into the Fen River and drowned.
units.literal: Yongzong came out to fight, suffered a great defeat, the Six Armies pressed the pursuit, his host collapsed, Yongzong was beheaded, and men and women, young and old alike, all threw themselves into the Fen River and died.

units.zh: 七年六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 7, on the guiwei new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, on the first day guiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「不臣欲殺」。
units.en: The omen reads: "A disloyal subject plots murder."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "A subject who is not loyal seeks to kill."

units.zh: 八年三月，河西王沮渠牧犍謀反，伏誅。
units.en: In the third month of year 8, Juqu Mujian, King of Hexi, plotted rebellion and was put to death.
units.literal: In the third month of the eighth year, the King of Hexi Juqu Mujian plotted rebellion and was executed.

units.zh: 十年夏四月丙申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in year 10, on the bingshen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month of the tenth year, on the first day bingshen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 六月庚寅朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month, on the gengyin new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「將相誅」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Generals and ministers will be put to death."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Generals and ministers will be executed."

units.zh: 十一年六月己亥，誅司徒崔浩。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 11, on jihai day, Minister of Works Cui Hao was executed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, on the day jihai, Minister of Works Cui Hao was executed.

units.zh: 十一年十二月辛未，日南北有珥。
units.en: In the twelfth month of year 11, on xinwei day, mock suns appeared north and south of the disk.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year, on the day xinwei, there were solar mock-suns to the north and south of the sun.

units.zh: 高宗興安元年十一月己卯，日出赤如血。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Xing'an 1, during the reign of Emperor Wencheng, on jimao day, the sun rose blood-red.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Xing'an under Emperor Gaozong, on the day jimao, the sun rose red as blood.

units.zh: 二年三月，日暈。
units.en: In the third month of year 2, a solar halo appeared.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year, there was a solar halo.

units.zh: 興光元年七月丙申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month of Xingguang 1, on the bingshen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Xingguang, on the first day bingshen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 和平元年九月庚申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the ninth month of Heping 1, on the gengshen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Heping, on the first day gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年二月壬子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the second month of year 3, on the renzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year, on the first day renzi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有白衣之會」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The court will don mourning white."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a gathering in white garments."

units.zh: 六年五月癸卯，高宗崩。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 6, on guimao day, Emperor Wencheng died.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, on the day guimao, Emperor Gaozong passed away.

units.zh: 顯祖皇興元年十月己卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the tenth month of Huangxing 1, during the reign of Emperor Xianwen, on the jimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Huangxing under Emperor Xianzu, on the first day jimao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年四月丙子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fourth month of year 2, on the bingzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, on the first day bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「將誅」。
units.en: The omen reads: "A general will be put to death."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "A general will be executed."

units.zh: 四年十月，誅濟南王慕容白曜。
units.en: In the tenth month of year 4, Murong Baiyao, Prince of Jinan, was executed.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Prince of Jinan Murong Baiyao was executed.

units.zh: 十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the tenth month, on the guiyou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the first day guiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「尊后有憂」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The chief consort will suffer affliction."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The honored empress will have cause for grief."

units.zh: 三年，夫人李氏薨，後諡思皇后。
units.en: In year 3, Lady Li died; she was later posthumously honored as Empress Si.
units.literal: In the third year, Lady Li passed away; later she was given the posthumous title Empress Si.

units.zh: 三年十月丁酉朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the tenth month of year 3, on the dingyou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, on the first day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 高祖延興元年十二月癸卯，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the twelfth month of Yanxing 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaowen, on guimao day, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Yanxing under Emperor Gaozu, on the day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有兵」。
units.en: The omen reads: "War will break out."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be warfare."

units.zh: 二年正月乙卯，統萬鎮胡民相率北叛，遣寧南將軍、交阯公韓拔等滅之。
units.en: In the first month of year 2, on yimao day, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rebelled en masse and fled north; General Who Pacifies the South, Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba and others were dispatched to crush them.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the day yimao, the Hu people of Tongwan garrison rose in rebellion together and fled north; Ningnan General, Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba and others were sent to destroy them.

units.zh: 三年十二月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the twelfth month of year 3, on the guimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 四年正月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of year 4, on the guiyou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the first day guiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: [2]占曰「有崩主，天下改服。
units.en: [2] The omen reads: "The sovereign will die and the realm will go into mourning.
units.literal: [2] The prognostication says: "The ruler will die; the realm will change its garments.

units.zh: 有大臣死」。
units.en: A great minister will die as well."
units.literal: A great minister will die."

units.zh: 五年十二月己丑，征北大將軍城陽王壽薨。
units.en: In the twelfth month of year 5, on jichou day, Shou, Prince of Chengyang and Grand General Who Campaigns North, died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the fifth year, on the day jichou, Grand General Who Campaigns North, Prince of Chengyang Shou, passed away.

units.zh: 六年六月辛未，顯祖崩。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 6, on xinwei day, Emperor Xianwen died.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, on the day xinwei, Emperor Xianzu passed away.

units.zh: 七月丙寅，日有背珥。
units.en: In the seventh month, on bingyin day, the sun showed a back halo with mock suns.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the day bingyin, the sun had a back halo and mock-suns.

units.zh: 五年正月丁酉，白虹貫日，直珥一。
units.en: In the first month of year 5, on dingyou day, a white rainbow crossed the sun, with one straight mock sun.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on the day dingyou, a white rainbow pierced the sun, with one straight mock-sun.

units.zh: 承明元年三月辛卯，日暈五重，有二珥。
units.en: In the third month of Chengming 1, on xinmao day, a five-ring solar halo appeared with two mock suns.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Chengming, on the day xinmao, there was a solar halo of five rings, with two mock-suns.

units.zh: 太和元年冬十月辛亥朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter in Taihe 1, on the xinhai new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month of the first year of Taihe, on the first day xinhai, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年正月辛亥，日暈，東西有珥。
units.en: In the first month of year 2, on xinhai day, a solar halo appeared with mock suns east and west.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the day xinhai, there was a solar halo with mock-suns to the east and west.

units.zh: 二月乙酉晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the second month, on yiyou day, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day yiyou, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: [3]占曰「有欲反者，近三月，遠三年」。
units.en: [3] The omen reads: "Rebellion is brewing—within three months at the nearest, within three years at the farthest."
units.literal: [3] The prognostication says: "There are those who wish to rebel—within three months if near, within three years if far."

units.zh: 四年正月癸卯，洮陽羌叛，枹罕鎮將討平之。
units.en: In the first month of year 4, on guimao day, the Qiang of Taoyang rebelled; the commander of Baohan garrison suppressed them.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the day guimao, the Qiang of Taoyang rebelled; the garrison commander of Baohan attacked and pacified them.

units.zh: 九月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the ninth month, on the yisi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「東邦發兵」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The eastern regions will mobilize troops."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The eastern states will raise armies."

units.zh: 四年十月丁未，蘭陵民桓富殺其縣令，與昌慮桓和北連太山羣盜張和顏等，聚黨保五固，推司馬朗之為主，詔淮陽王尉元等討之。
units.en: In the tenth month of year 4, on dingwei day, Huan Fu of Lanling killed his county magistrate; with Huan He of Changlu he joined the Mount Tai bandits Zhang Heyan, rallied at Wugu, and set up Sima Langzhi as their leader; the court ordered Prince Wei Yuan of Huaiyang and others to suppress them.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, on the day dingwei, the commoner Huan Fu of Lanling killed his county magistrate; together with Huan He of Changlu he linked with the bandit chiefs Zhang Heyan of Mount Tai and others, gathered a band to hold Wugu, and set up Sima Langzhi as leader; an edict ordered Prince of Huaiyang Wei Yuan and others to attack them.

units.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，日暈，東西有珥，有佩戟一重，北有偃戟四重，後有白氣貫日珥，狀如車輪。
units.en: In the first month of spring in year 3, on guichou day, a solar halo appeared with mock suns east and west, one tier of pendant halberds, four tiers of reclining halberds to the north, and then white vapor crossing the mock suns in the shape of a carriage wheel.
units.literal: In spring, the first month of the third year, on the day guichou, there was a solar halo with mock-suns east and west, one layer of pendant halberds, four layers of reclining halberds to the north, and afterward white vapor piercing the sun's mock-suns in the shape of a carriage wheel.

units.zh: 京師不見，雍州以聞。
units.en: The capital did not see it; Yong Province reported the phenomenon.
units.literal: It was not seen in the capital; Yong Province reported it.

units.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third month, on the guimao new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third month, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「大臣誅」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Great ministers will be put to death."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Great ministers will be executed."

units.zh: 四月，雍州刺史宜都王目辰有罪，賜死。
units.en: In the fourth month, Muchen, Prince of Yidu and governor of Yong Province, was found guilty and ordered to take his own life.
units.literal: In the fourth month, Muchen, Prince of Yidu and Governor of Yong Province, was guilty and granted death.

units.zh: 四年正月辛酉，日東西有珥，北有佩，日暈貫兩珥。
units.en: In the first month of year 4, on xinyou day, mock suns appeared east and west, a pendant ornament to the north, and a halo crossing both mock suns.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the day xinyou, there were mock-suns east and west of the sun, a pendant to the north, and a solar halo piercing both mock-suns.

units.zh: 五年正月庚辰，日暈，東西有珥；
units.en: In the first month of year 5, on gengchen day, a solar halo appeared with mock suns east and west;
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on the day gengchen, there was a solar halo with mock-suns east and west;

units.zh: 南北並白氣，長一丈，廣二尺許；
units.en: north and south showed white vapor one zhang long and about two chi wide;
units.literal: to the north and south were both white vapors, one zhang in length and about two chi in breadth;

units.zh: 北有連環暈。
units.en: to the north there was a chain of halos.
units.literal: to the north there was a linked-ring halo.

units.zh: 又貫珥內，復有直氣，長三丈許，內黃，中青，外白。
units.en: It pierced through the mock suns again, and a straight vapor about three zhang long appeared, yellow within, blue-green in the middle, and white without.
units.literal: Again it pierced within the mock-suns, and there was again a straight vapor about three zhang long, yellow within, blue-green in the middle, and white without.

units.zh: 暈乍成，散，乃滅。
units.en: The halo formed abruptly, then scattered and disappeared.
units.literal: The halo suddenly formed, dispersed, and then vanished.

units.zh: 七月庚申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month, on the gengshen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 七年十二月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the twelfth month of year 7, on the yisi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 八年正月戊寅，有白氣貫日。
units.en: In the first month of year 8, on wuyin day, white vapor crossed the sun.
units.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, on the day wuyin, there was white vapor piercing the sun.

units.zh: 占曰「近臣亂」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Intimates at court will stir rebellion."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Close ministers will cause disorder."

units.zh: 十年三月丁亥，中散梁眾保等謀反，伏誅。
units.en: In the third month of year 10, on dinghai day, Palace Attendant Liang Zhongbao and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.
units.literal: In the third month of the tenth year, on the day dinghai, Palace Attendant Liang Zhongbao and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

units.zh: 十一年十一月丁亥，日失色。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 11, on dinghai day, the sun dimmed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year, on the day dinghai, the sun lost its color.

units.zh: 十二年三月戊戌，白虹貫日。
units.en: In the third month of year 12, on wuxu day, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, on the day wuxu, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 十三年二月乙亥朔，日十五分蝕八。
units.en: In the second month of year 13, on the yihai new moon, a partial eclipse covered eight fifteenths of the sun.
units.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year, on the first day yihai, in a partial eclipse eight fifteenths of the sun were obscured.

units.zh: 占曰「有白衣之會」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The court will don mourning white."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a gathering in white garments."

units.zh: 十一月己未，安豐王猛薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, Meng, Prince of Anfeng, died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiwei, Prince of Anfeng Meng passed away.

units.zh: 十四年二月己巳朔未時，雲氣班駁，日十五分蝕一。
units.en: In the second month of year 14, on the jisi new moon at the wei hour, mottled clouds gathered and a partial eclipse covered one fifteenth of the sun.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourteenth year, on the first day jisi at the wei hour, cloud vapors were mottled; in a partial eclipse one fifteenth of the sun was obscured.

units.zh: 占曰「有白衣之會」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The court will don mourning white."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a gathering in white garments."

units.zh: 九月癸丑，文明太皇太后馮氏崩。
units.en: In the ninth month, on guichou day, Grand Empress Dowager Feng, the Civilized and Illustrious, died.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guichou, the Civilized and Illustrious Grand Empress Dowager Lady Feng passed away.

units.zh: 十五年正月癸亥晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of year 15, on guihai day, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year, on the day guihai, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「王者將兵，天下擾動」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The sovereign will take the field and the realm will be thrown into turmoil."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The king will lead troops; the realm under heaven will be disturbed."

units.zh: 十七年六月丙戌，高祖南伐。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 17, on bingxu day, Emperor Xiaowen launched his southern campaign.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, on the day bingxu, Emperor Gaozu marched south on campaign.

units.zh: 十七年六月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 17, on the gengchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十八年五月甲戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 18, on the jiaxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the eighteenth year, on the first day jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二十年九月庚寅晦，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the ninth month of year 20, on gengyin day, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the twentieth year, on the day gengyin, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二十三年六月己卯，日中有黑氣。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 23, on jimao day, black vapor appeared within the sun.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year, on the day jimao, there was black vapor within the sun.

units.zh: 占曰「內有逆謀」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Treason is brewing within the court."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Within there is treasonous plotting."

units.zh: 八月癸亥，南徐州刺史沈陵南叛。
units.en: In the eighth month, on guihai day, Shen Ling, governor of Southern Xuzhou, defected to the south.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guihai, Shen Ling, Governor of Southern Xuzhou, rebelled and fled south.

units.zh: 十二月甲申，日中有黑氣，大如桃。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on jiashen day, black vapor within the sun grew as large as a peach.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiashen, there was black vapor within the sun, as large as a peach.

units.zh: 世宗景明元年正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of Jingming 1, during the reign of Emperor Xuanwu, on the xinchou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jingming under Emperor Shizong, on the first day xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 七月己亥朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month, on the jihai new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day jihai, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年四月癸酉，日自午及未再暈，內黃外白。
units.en: In the fourth month of year 2, on guiyou day, from the wu hour through the wei hour the sun showed a double halo, yellow within and white without.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, on the day guiyou, from the wu hour through the wei hour the sun was doubly haloed, yellow within and white without.

units.zh: 七月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month, on the guisi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day guisi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 八月戊辰，日赤無光，中有黑子一。
units.en: In the eighth month, on wuchen day, the sun turned red and dim, with a single black spot upon it.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, the sun was red and without radiance, with one black spot within it.

units.zh: 三年正月乙巳，日中有黑氣如鵝子，申、酉復見；
units.en: In the first month of year 3, on yisi day, black vapor within the sun swelled like a goose egg; it reappeared at the shen and you hours;
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, on the day yisi, there was black vapor within the sun like a goose egg; it reappeared at the shen and you hours;

units.zh: 又有二黑氣橫貫日。
units.en: and two streaks of black vapor crossed the sun horizontally.
units.literal: and again there were two black vapors crossing the sun horizontally.

units.zh: 二月辛卯，日中有黑氣，大如鵝子。
units.en: In the second month, on xinmao day, black vapor within the sun grew as large as a goose egg.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day xinmao, there was black vapor within the sun, as large as a goose egg.

units.zh: 七月丁巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the seventh month, on the dingsi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day dingsi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 正始元年十二月丙戌，黑氣貫日。
units.en: In the twelfth month of Zhengshi 1, on bingxu day, black vapor crossed the sun.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Zhengshi, on the day bingxu, black vapor pierced the sun.

units.zh: 壬子，日有冠珥，內黃外青。
units.en: On renzi day, the sun showed a crown halo and mock suns, yellow within and blue-green without.
units.literal: On renzi, the sun had a crown and mock-suns, yellow within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 占曰「天下喜」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The realm will rejoice."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The realm under heaven rejoices."

units.zh: 三年正月丁卯，皇子生，大赦天下。
units.en: In the first month of year 3, on dingmao day, a prince was born and a general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, on the day dingmao, an imperial son was born and a great amnesty was proclaimed for the realm.

units.zh: 三年二月甲辰，日左右有珥，內赤外黃。
units.en: In the second month of year 3, on jiachen day, mock suns appeared to either side of the disk, red within and yellow without.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year, on the day jiachen, there were mock-suns to the left and right of the sun, red within and yellow without.

units.zh: 辛亥，日暈，外白內黃。
units.en: On xinhai day, a solar halo appeared, white without and yellow within.
units.literal: On xinhai, there was a solar halo, white without and yellow within.

units.zh: 十月乙巳，日赤無光。
units.en: In the tenth month, on yisi day, the sun turned red and dim.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the day yisi, the sun was red and without radiance.

units.zh: 十二月乙卯，日暈，內黃外青，東西有珥，北有背。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, a solar halo appeared, yellow within and blue-green without, with mock suns east and west and a back halo to the north.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yimao, there was a solar halo, yellow within and blue-green without, with mock-suns east and west and a back halo to the north.

units.zh: 巳時，白虹貫日。
units.en: At the si hour, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: At the si hour, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 永平元年三月己酉，日南北有珥，外青內黃，暈不匝；
units.en: In the third month of Yongping 1, on jiyou day, mock suns appeared north and south, blue-green without and yellow within, and the halo did not complete its ring;
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Yongping, on the day jiyou, there were mock-suns north and south of the sun, blue-green without and yellow within, and the halo did not encircle fully;

units.zh: 西北有直氣，長尺餘；
units.en: to the northwest a straight vapor more than a chi long;
units.literal: to the northwest was straight vapor more than a chi in length;

units.zh: 北有白虹貫日。
units.en: to the north a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: to the north was a white rainbow piercing the sun.

units.zh: 八月壬子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day renzi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年八月丙午朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eighth month of year 2, on the bingwu new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, on the first day bingwu, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丁卯旦，日旁有黑氣，形如月，從東南來衝日。
units.en: At dawn on dingmao day, black vapor beside the sun took the shape of the moon and rushed upon the sun from the southeast.
units.literal: At dawn on dingmao, beside the sun was black vapor in the shape of the moon, coming from the southeast to strike the sun.

units.zh: 如此者一辰，乃滅。
units.en: It lasted one double-hour watch, then disappeared.
units.literal: It was thus for one double-hour period, then vanished.

units.zh: 三年二月甲子，日中有黑氣二。
units.en: In the second month of year 3, on jiazi day, two black spots appeared within the sun.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year, on the day jiazi, there were two black vapors within the sun.

units.zh: 十二月乙未，日交暈，中赤外黃，東西有珥，南北白暈貫日，皆匝。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on yiwei day, crossed halos appeared, red at center and yellow without, with mock suns east and west; white halos north and south crossed the sun in a full ring.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiwei, there was a crossed solar halo, red in the center and yellow without, with mock-suns east and west; white halos north and south pierced the sun, all encircling fully.

units.zh: 四年十一月癸卯，日中有黑氣二，大如桃。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 4, on guimao day, two black spots within the sun grew as large as peaches.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on the day guimao, there were two black vapors within the sun, as large as peaches.

units.zh: 占曰「天子崩」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The emperor will die."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven will die."

units.zh: 延昌四年正月丁巳，世宗昇遐。
units.en: In the first month of Yanchang 4, on dingsi day, Emperor Xuanwu passed away.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Yanchang, on the day dingsi, Emperor Shizong ascended to the remote.

units.zh: 十二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之，在牛四度。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on the renxu new moon, the sun was eclipsed at four degrees in the Ox asterism.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day renxu, there was a solar eclipse, at four degrees in the Ox asterism.

units.zh: 占曰「其國叛兵發」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Rebel armies will rise in the realm."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "In that state rebel armies will rise."

units.zh: 延昌二年二月庚辰，[4]蕭衍郁洲民徐玄明等斬送衍鎮北將軍、青冀二州刺史張稷首，以州內附。
units.en: In the second month of Yanchang 2, on gengchen day, [4] Xu Xuanming and others of Yuzhou under Liang emperor Xiao Yan beheaded Zhang Ji, Liang's General Who Guards the North and governor of Qing and Ji, and surrendered the province to Wei.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year of Yanchang, on the day gengchen, [4] Xu Xuanming and others, commoners of Yuzhou under Xiao Yan, beheaded and sent the head of Yan's General Who Guards the North and Governor of Qing and Ji Provinces Zhang Ji, and submitted the province to allegiance.

units.zh: 延昌元年二月甲戌至于辛巳，日初出及將沒，赤白無光明。
units.en: From jiaxu through xinsi in the second month of Yanchang 1, at sunrise and sunset the sun showed red and white without brightness.
units.literal: From the second month of the first year of Yanchang, from the day jiaxu through xinsi, at the sun's first rising and as it was about to set, it was red and white without radiance.

units.zh: 五月己未晦，日十五分蝕九。
units.en: On jiwei day, the last day of the fifth month, a partial eclipse covered nine fifteenths of the sun.
units.literal: On the day jiwei, the last day of the fifth month, in a partial eclipse nine fifteenths of the sun were obscured.

units.zh: 占曰「大旱，民流千里」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Severe drought will drive the people to wander far from home."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Great drought; the people wander a thousand li."

units.zh: 二年春，京師民饑，死者數萬口。
units.en: In the spring of year 2, famine struck the capital; tens of thousands perished.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, the people of the capital suffered famine; tens of thousands died.

units.zh: 二年閏月辛亥，日中有黑氣。
units.en: In the intercalary month of year 2, on xinhai day, black vapor appeared within the sun.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the second year, on the day xinhai, there was black vapor within the sun.

units.zh: 占曰「內有逆謀」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Treason is brewing within the court."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Within there is treasonous plotting."

units.zh: 三年十一月丁巳，幽州沙門劉僧紹聚眾反，自號淨居國明法王，州郡捕斬之。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 3, on dingsi day, the monk Liu Sengshao of You Province raised a rebellion, proclaimed himself Bright Dharma King of the Pure Dwelling Kingdom, and was captured and executed by local authorities.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day dingsi, the monk Liu Sengshao of You Province gathered a host in rebellion, styled himself Bright Dharma King of the Pure Dwelling Kingdom, and was captured and beheaded by the province and commanderies.

units.zh: 五月甲寅朔，日有蝕之，京師不見，恒州以聞。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the jiayin new moon, the sun was eclipsed; the capital did not see it, and Heng Province reported the phenomenon.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day jiayin, there was a solar eclipse; it was not seen in the capital, and Heng Province reported it.

units.zh: 三年三月庚申，日交暈，其色內赤黃，外青白；
units.en: In the third month of year 3, on gengshen day, crossed halos appeared, red-yellow within and blue-white without;
units.literal: In the third month of the third year, on the day gengshen, there was a crossed solar halo, its color red-yellow within and blue-white without;

units.zh: 南北有佩，可長二丈許，內赤黃，外青白；
units.en: north and south showed pendant ornaments about two zhang long, red-yellow within and blue-white without;
units.literal: to the north and south were pendants about two zhang in length, red-yellow within and blue-white without;

units.zh: 西有白暈貫日。
units.en: to the west a white halo crossed the sun.
units.literal: to the west was a white halo piercing the sun.

units.zh: 又日東有一抱，長二丈許，內赤黃，外青。
units.en: East of the sun an embrace-shaped halo about two zhang long appeared, red-yellow within and blue without.
units.literal: Again to the east of the sun was one embrace about two zhang in length, red-yellow within and blue without.

units.zh: 肅宗熙平元年三月戊辰朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third month of Xiping 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaoming, on the wuchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xiping under Emperor Xiaoming, on the day wuchen at new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丁丑，日出無光，至于酉時。
units.en: On dingchou day the sun rose without light and remained so until the you hour.
units.literal: On dingchou, the sun rose without light until the you hour.

units.zh: 占曰「兵起」。
units.en: The omen reads: "War will break out."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies will rise."

units.zh: 神龜元年正月，秦州羌反；
units.en: In the first month of Shengui 1 the Qiang of Qinzhou rose in rebellion;
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Shengui, the Qiang of Qinzhou rebelled;

units.zh: 二月己酉，東益州氐反；
units.en: in the second month, on jiyou day, the Di of Eastern Yizhou rebelled;
units.literal: in the second month, on jiyou, the Di of Eastern Yizhou rebelled;

units.zh: 七月，河州民却鐵怱聚眾反，自稱水池王。
units.en: in the seventh month the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of the Water Pool.
units.literal: in the seventh month, the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of the Water Pool.

units.zh: 四月甲辰卯時，日暈帀；
units.en: In the fourth month, on jiachen day at the mao hour, a full solar halo appeared;
units.literal: In the fourth month, on the day jiachen at the mao hour, the solar halo encircled fully;

units.zh: 西有一背，內赤外黃；
units.en: to the west a back halo, red within and yellow without;
units.literal: to the west was one back halo, red within and yellow without;

units.zh: 南北有珥，內赤外黃；
units.en: north and south showed mock suns, red within and yellow without;
units.literal: to the north and south were mock-suns, red within and yellow without;

units.zh: 漸滅。
units.en: then it gradually faded away.
units.literal: it gradually vanished.

units.zh: 十二月己酉，日暈，北有一抱，內赤外白，兩傍有珥，北有白虹貫日。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on jiyou day, a solar halo appeared; to the north an embrace-shaped halo, red within and white without, with mock suns on both flanks and a white rainbow crossing the sun to the north.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiyou, there was a solar halo; to the north was one embrace, red within and white without, with mock-suns on both sides, and to the north a white rainbow piercing the sun.

units.zh: 神龜元年三月丁丑，白虹貫日。
units.en: In the third month of Shengui 1, on dingchou day, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Shengui, on the day dingchou, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 占曰「天下有來臣之眾，不三年」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Foreign peoples will come to submit within three years."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Under heaven there will be a host coming to submit as subjects, within three years."

units.zh: 十一月乙酉，[5]蠕蠕莫緣梁賀侯豆率男女七百口來降。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, [5] Moyuan Liang Hehoudou of the Rouran led seven hundred men and women to surrender.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, [5] Moyuan Liang Hehoudou of the Rouran led seven hundred men and women to surrender.

units.zh: 二年正月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of year 2, on the xinsi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the first day xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 正光元年正月乙亥朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first month of Zhengguang 1, on the yihai new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhengguang, on the first day yihai, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有大臣亡」。
units.en: The omen reads: "A great minister will die."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "A great minister will perish."

units.zh: 七月丙子，殺太傅、領太尉、清河王懌。
units.en: In the seventh month, on bingzi day, Yi, Prince of Qinghe, Grand Tutor and concurrent Grand Commandant, was put to death.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the day bingzi, Grand Tutor and Concurrent Grand Commandant Prince of Qinghe Yi was killed.

units.zh: 二年五月丁酉，日有蝕之，夏州以聞。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 2, on dingyou day, the sun was eclipsed; Xia Province reported the phenomenon.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, on the day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse; Xia Province reported it.

units.zh: 三年正月甲寅，日交暈，內赤外青，有白虹貫暈；
units.en: In the first month of year 3, on jiayin day, crossed halos appeared, red within and blue-green without, with a white rainbow crossing the halo;
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, on the day jiayin, there was a crossed solar halo, red within and blue-green without, with a white rainbow piercing the halo;

units.zh: 外有直氣，長二丈許，內赤外青。
units.en: outside was straight vapor about two zhang long, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: without was straight vapor about two zhang in length, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the renchen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day renchen, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「秦邦不臣」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Qin will produce disloyal subjects."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The Qin region will not be loyal subjects."

units.zh: 五年六月，秦州城人莫折大提據城反，自稱秦王。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 5, Moqi Dati of Qinzhou seized the city in rebellion and proclaimed himself King of Qin.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Moqi Dati of Qinzhou, a townsman, seized the city in rebellion and styled himself King of Qin.

units.zh: 十月己巳，太史奏自八月已來，黃埃掩日，日出三丈，色赤如赭，無光曜。
units.en: In the tenth month, on jisi day, the Grand Clerk reported that since the eighth month yellow dust had veiled the sun; when it rose three zhang high its color was ochre-red and without brightness.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the day jisi, the Grand Clerk memorialized that from the eighth month onward yellow dust veiled the sun; when it rose three zhang high, its color was red as ochre and without radiance.

units.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the jichou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day jichou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有小兵，在西北」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Minor warfare will break out in the northwest."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be minor warfare in the northwest."

units.zh: 四年二月己卯，蠕蠕主阿那瓌率眾犯塞。
units.en: In the second month of year 4, on jimao day, the Rouran ruler Anagui led his forces across the frontier.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, on the day jimao, the Rouran ruler Anagui led his host to violate the frontier passes.

units.zh: 四年十一月癸未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 4, on the guiwei new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on the first day guiwei, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 五年閏月乙酉，日暈，內赤外青；
units.en: In the intercalary month of year 5, on yiyou day, a solar halo appeared, red within and blue-green without;
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the fifth year, on the day yiyou, there was a solar halo, red within and blue-green without;

units.zh: 南有珥，上有一抱兩背，內赤外青。
units.en: to the south mock suns, above them one embrace and two back halos, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: to the south were mock-suns, above them one embrace and two back halos, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 三月丁卯，日暈三重，外青內赤。
units.en: In the third month, on dingmao day, a triple solar halo appeared, blue-green without and red within.
units.literal: In the third month, on dingmao, there was a triple solar halo, blue-green without and red within.

units.zh: 占曰「有謀其主」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Someone will plot against the sovereign."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be plotting against the ruler."

units.zh: 孝昌元年正月庚申，徐州刺史元法僧據城反，自稱宋王。
units.en: In the first month of Xiaochang 1, on gengshen day, Yuan Faseng, Inspector of Xuzhou, seized the city and rebelled, styling himself King of Song.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xiaochang, on gengshen, Yuan Faseng, Inspector of Xuzhou, occupied the city and rebelled, styling himself King of Song.

units.zh: 十二月丙申，日暈，南北有珥，上有兩抱一背。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on bingshen day, a solar halo appeared with mock suns north and south and two embraces and one back halo above.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, there was a solar halo, with mock-suns north and south and above them two embraces and one back halo.

units.zh: 孝昌元年十二月丙戌，白虹刺日不過，虹中有一背。
units.en: In the twelfth month of Xiaochang 1, on bingxu day, a white rainbow struck the sun without crossing it; within the rainbow was a back halo.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Xiaochang, on the day bingxu, a white rainbow stabbed the sun but did not pass through; within the rainbow was one back halo.

units.zh: 占曰「有臣背其主」，一曰「有反城」。
units.en: The omen reads: "A minister will betray his sovereign," or alternatively, "A city will rebel."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "A minister turns against his lord," or alternatively, "There is a rebellious city."

units.zh: 三年九月己卯，[6]東豫州刺史元慶和據城南叛。
units.en: In the ninth month of year 3, on jimao day, [6] Yuan Qinghe, governor of Eastern Yuzhou, seized the city and defected southward.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, on the day jimao, [6] Yuan Qinghe, Governor of Eastern Yuzhou, seized the city and rebelled to the south.

units.zh: 三年十一月戊寅辰時，日暈，東面不合，其色內赤外黃；
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 3, on wuyin day at the chen hour, a solar halo appeared; the eastern arc did not close, red within and yellow without;
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day wuyin at the chen hour, there was a solar halo; the eastern side did not close, its color red within and yellow without;

units.zh: 東西有珥，內赤外黃；
units.en: east and west showed mock suns, red within and yellow without;
units.literal: to the east and west were mock-suns, red within and yellow without;

units.zh: 西北去暈一尺餘，有一背，長二丈餘，廣三尺許，內赤外黃。
units.en: to the northwest, a little over a chi from the halo, a back halo more than two zhang long and about three chi wide, red within and yellow without.
units.literal: to the northwest, more than a chi from the halo, was one back halo more than two zhang in length and about three chi in breadth, red within and yellow without.

units.zh: 莊帝永安二年三月甲戌未時，日暈三重，內黃赤，外青白，暈東西兩處不合，其狀如抱。
units.en: In the third month of Yong'an 2, during the reign of Emperor Zhuang, on jiaxu day at the wei hour, a triple solar halo appeared, yellow-red within and blue-white without; the ring failed to close in two places east and west, shaped like an embrace.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year of Yong'an under Emperor Zhuang, on the day jiaxu at the wei hour, there was a triple solar halo, yellow-red within and blue-white without; the halo did not close in two places east and west, its form like an embrace.

units.zh: 五月辛酉，日暈，東西兩處不合。
units.en: In the fifth month, on xinyou day, a solar halo appeared with gaps east and west where the ring did not close.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinyou, there was a solar halo; in two places east and west it did not close.

units.zh: 辛未申時，日南有珥；
units.en: On xinwei day at the shen hour, mock suns appeared south of the disk;
units.literal: On xinwei at the shen hour, to the south of the sun were mock-suns;

units.zh: 去一尺餘有一背，長三丈許，廣五尺餘，內赤外青。
units.en: a little over a chi away a back halo about three zhang long and more than five chi wide, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: more than a chi away was one back halo about three zhang in length and more than five chi in breadth, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 七月丙寅，直東去日三尺許有一背，長二丈餘，內赤外青。
units.en: In the seventh month, on bingyin day, due east about three chi from the sun a back halo more than two zhang long appeared, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the day bingyin, due east about three chi from the sun was one back halo more than two zhang in length, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 半食頃，從北頭漸滅至半，須臾還如初見，內赤外青，其色分炳。
units.en: Over the space of half a meal it faded from the northern end to the midpoint, then in a moment returned to its original form, red within and blue-green without, its colors sharply defined.
units.literal: For the space of half a meal, from the northern end it gradually vanished to the halfway point; in a moment it returned as at first sight, red within and blue-green without, its colors clearly distinct.

units.zh: 十月己酉朔，日從地下蝕出，十五分蝕七，虧從西南角起。
units.en: In the tenth month, on the jiyou new moon, the eclipse rose from below the horizon; seven fifteenths of the sun were obscured, and the bite began at the southwest limb.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the first day jiyou, the eclipse emerged from below the earth; in the partial eclipse seven fifteenths of the sun were obscured, and the bite began at the southwest limb.

units.zh: 占曰「西夷欲殺，後有大兵，必西行」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Western peoples will seek bloodshed; afterward great armies will march west."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Western barbarians wish to kill; afterward there will be great armies that must march west."

units.zh: 三年四月丁卯，雍州刺史尒朱天光討擒万俟醜奴、蕭寶夤於安定，送京師斬之。
units.en: In the fourth month of year 3, on dingmao day, Erzhu Tianguang, governor of Yong Province, captured Wanqi Chounu and Xiao Baoyin at Anding, sent them to the capital, and had them executed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, on the day dingmao, Erzhu Tianguang, Governor of Yong Province, attacked and captured Wanqi Chounu and Xiao Baoyin at Anding, sent them to the capital, and beheaded them.

units.zh: 三年五月戊戌辰時，日暈帀，內赤外白，暈內有兩珥；
units.en: In the fifth month of year 3, on wuxu day at the chen hour, a full solar halo appeared, red within and white without, with two mock suns inside the ring;
units.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, on the day wuxu at the chen hour, the solar halo encircled fully, red within and white without, with two mock-suns within the halo;

units.zh: 西有白虹貫日；
units.en: to the west a white rainbow crossed the sun;
units.literal: to the west was a white rainbow piercing the sun;

units.zh: 東北有一背，內赤外青；
units.en: to the northeast one back halo, red within and blue-green without;
units.literal: to the northeast was one back halo, red within and blue-green without;

units.zh: 南有一背，內赤外青；
units.en: to the south one back halo, red within and blue-green without;
units.literal: to the south was one back halo, red within and blue-green without;

units.zh: 東有一抱，內青外赤。
units.en: to the east an embrace-shaped halo, blue-green within and red without.
units.literal: to the east was one embrace, blue-green within and red without.

units.zh: 京師不見，青州表聞。
units.en: The capital did not see it; Qing Province reported the phenomenon.
units.literal: It was not seen in the capital; Qing Province reported it by memorial.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，日暈，白虹貫日。
units.en: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, a solar halo appeared and a white rainbow crossed the sun.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, there was a solar halo and a white rainbow piercing the sun.

units.zh: 前廢帝普泰元年三月丁亥，日月並赤赭色，天地溷濁。
units.en: In the third month of Putai 1, during the reign of the Former Deposed Emperor, on dinghai day, the sun and moon both turned ochre-red, and heaven and earth grew murky and dim.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Putai under the Former Deposed Emperor, on the day dinghai, the sun and moon were both ochre-red, and heaven and earth were murky and turbid.

units.zh: 六月己亥朔，日蝕從西南角起，雲陰不見，定相二州表聞。
units.en: In the sixth month, on the jihai new moon, the eclipse began at the southwest limb; clouds hid it from view, and Ding and Xiang Provinces reported the phenomenon.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day jihai, the solar eclipse began at the southwest limb; clouds and shade obscured it from view, and Ding and Xiang Provinces reported it by memorial.

units.zh: 占曰「主弱，小人持政」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The sovereign is weak and petty men hold power."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler is weak; petty men hold government."

units.zh: 時尒朱世隆兄弟專擅威福。
units.en: At the time the Erzhu brothers Shilong and his kin monopolized power and patronage.
units.literal: At the time the Erzhu brothers Shilong and others monopolized authority and favor.

units.zh: 後廢帝中興二年二月辛丑辰時，日暈，東西不合，其色內赤外青；
units.en: In the second month of Zhongxing 2, during the reign of the Later Deposed Emperor, on xinchou day at the chen hour, a solar halo appeared with gaps east and west where the ring did not close, red within and blue-green without;
units.literal: In the second month of the second year of Zhongxing under the Later Deposed Emperor, on the day xinchou at the chen hour, there was a solar halo; east and west did not close, its color red within and blue-green without;

units.zh: 南北有珥；
units.en: north and south showed mock suns;
units.literal: to the north and south were mock-suns;

units.zh: 西北去暈一尺餘有一背，長二丈許，可廣三尺，內赤外青。
units.en: to the northwest, a little over a chi from the halo, a back halo about two zhang long and three chi wide, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: to the northwest, more than a chi from the halo, was one back halo about two zhang in length and about three chi in breadth, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 十一月，日暈再重；
units.en: In the eleventh month, a double solar halo appeared;
units.literal: In the eleventh month, the sun was doubly haloed;

units.zh: 上有背，長三丈餘，內青外赤。
units.en: above it a back halo more than three zhang long, blue-green within and red without.
units.literal: above it was a back halo more than three zhang in length, blue-green within and red without.

units.zh: 出帝太昌元年五月，日暈再重；
units.en: In the fifth month of Taichang 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaowu, a double solar halo appeared;
units.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Taichang under Emperor Xiaowu, the sun was doubly haloed;

units.zh: 上有兩背，一尺許。
units.en: above it two back halos about a chi long.
units.literal: above it were two back halos about a chi in length.

units.zh: 癸丑午時，日南有珥；
units.en: On guichou day at the wu hour, mock suns appeared south of the disk;
units.literal: On guichou at the wu hour, to the south of the sun were mock-suns;

units.zh: 去日一尺餘有一背，長三丈許，廣五尺，內赤外青。
units.en: a little over a chi from the sun a back halo about three zhang long and five chi wide, red within and blue-green without.
units.literal: more than a chi from the sun was one back halo about three zhang in length and five chi in breadth, red within and blue-green without.

units.zh: 十月辛酉朔，日從地下蝕出，虧從西南角起。
units.en: In the tenth month, on the xinyou new moon, the eclipse rose from below the horizon, and the bite began at the southwest limb.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on the first day xinyou, the eclipse emerged from below the earth, and the bite began at the southwest limb.

units.zh: 占曰「有兵大行」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Armies will march on a great scale."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies will march on a great scale."

units.zh: 永熙二年正月甲午，齊獻武王自晉陽出討尒朱兆。
units.en: In the first month of Yongxi 2, on jiawu day, Prince Xian of Qi marched from Jinyang to campaign against Erzhu Zhao.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Yongxi, on the day jiawu, Prince Xian of Qi marched out from Jinyang to attack Erzhu Zhao.

units.zh: 丁酉，大破之於赤洪嶺，兆遁走自殺。
units.en: On dingyou day he routed them utterly at Red Flood Ridge; Zhao fled and took his own life.
units.literal: On dingyou he inflicted a great defeat on them at Red Flood Ridge; Zhao fled and killed himself.

units.zh: 永熙二年四月己未朔，日有蝕之，在丙，虧從正南起。
units.en: In the fourth month of Yongxi 2, on the jiwei new moon, the sun was eclipsed at bing; the bite began due south.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Yongxi, on the first day jiwei, there was a solar eclipse at bing; the bite began due south.

units.zh: 占曰「君陰謀」。
units.en: The omen reads: "The sovereign plots in secret."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The ruler plots in secret."

units.zh: 三年五月辛卯，出帝為斛斯椿等諸佞關構，猜於齊獻武王，託討蕭衍，盛暑徵發河南諸州之兵，天下怪惡之。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 3, on xinmao day, Emperor Xiaowu, swayed by flatterers such as Husu Chun, grew suspicious of Prince Xian of Qi; under the pretext of campaigning against Xiao Yan he conscripted troops from the Henan commanderies in midsummer, and the realm regarded it with horror.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, on the day xinmao, Emperor Xiaowu, because flatterers such as Husu Chun sowed discord between them, grew suspicious of Prince Xian of Qi; under the pretext of attacking Xiao Yan he conscripted troops from the Henan commanderies in the height of summer, and all under heaven regarded it with revulsion.

units.zh: 語在斛斯椿傳。
units.en: The full account appears in the biography of Husu Chun.
units.literal: The account is given in the biography of Husu Chun.

units.zh: 三年四月癸丑，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the fourth month of year 3, on guichou day, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, on the day guichou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有亂殺天子者」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Rebellion will arise and the emperor will be slain."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be disorder and one who kills the Son of Heaven."

units.zh: 七月丁未，出帝為斛斯椿等迫脅，遂出於長安。
units.en: In the seventh month, on dingwei day, Emperor Xiaowu was forced by Husu Chun and his faction to flee to Chang'an.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the day dingwei, Emperor Xiaowu was compelled by Husu Chun and others and thereupon departed for Chang'an.

units.zh: 孝靜元象元年春正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In spring, the first month of Yuanxiang 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaojing, on the xinchou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Yuanxiang under Emperor Xiaojing, on the day xinchou at new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「大臣死」。
units.en: The omen reads: "A high minister will die."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "A great minister will die."

units.zh: 八月辛卯，司徒公高敖曹戰歿於河陰。
units.en: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, fell in battle at Heyin.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao, Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao died in battle at Heyin.

units.zh: 六月己丑，日暈一重，有兩珥；
units.en: In the sixth month, on jichou day, a single-ring solar halo appeared with two mock suns;
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jichou, there was a single-ring solar halo with two mock-suns;

units.zh: 上有背，長二丈餘。
units.en: above them a back halo more than two zhang long.
units.literal: above it was a back halo more than two zhang long.

units.zh: 十一月己巳辰時，日暈，南面不合，東西有珥、背；
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jisi day at the chen hour, a solar halo appeared with a gap on the south side and mock suns and back halos east and west;
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi at the chen hour, there was a solar halo; the southern side did not close, and to the east and west were mock-suns and back halos;

units.zh: 有白虹，至珥不徹。
units.en: a white rainbow reached the mock suns without crossing through.
units.literal: there was a white rainbow reaching to the mock-suns without penetrating.

units.zh: 二年二月己丑巳時，日暈帀，白虹貫日不徹。
units.en: In the second month of year 2, on jichou day at the si hour, a full solar halo appeared, and a white rainbow struck the sun without crossing it.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year, on the day jichou at the si hour, the solar halo encircled fully, and a white rainbow pierced the sun without passing through.

units.zh: 興和二年閏月丁丑朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the intercalary month of Xinghe 2, on the dingchou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the second year of Xinghe, on the first day dingchou, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 占曰「有小兵」。
units.en: The omen reads: "Minor warfare will break out."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be minor warfare."

units.zh: 七月癸巳，元寶炬廣豫二州行臺趙繼宗、南青州刺史崔康寇陽翟，鎮將擊走之。
units.en: In the seventh month, on guisi day, Zhao Jizong of the Guang-Yu provisional headquarters under Yuan Baoju and Cui Kang, governor of Southern Qing Province, raided Yangdi; the garrison commander drove them off.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the day guisi, Zhao Jizong of the provisional headquarters for Guang and Yu Provinces under Yuan Baoju and Cui Kang, Governor of Southern Qing Province, raided Yangdi; the garrison commander drove them off.

units.zh: 武定三年冬十一月壬申，日暈兩重，東南角不合；
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter in Wuding 3, on renshen day, a double solar halo appeared with a gap in the southeast where the ring did not close;
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month of the third year of Wuding, on the day renshen, there was a double solar halo; the southeast corner did not close;

units.zh: 西南、東北有珥；
units.en: southwest and northeast showed mock suns;
units.literal: to the southwest and northeast were mock-suns;

units.zh: 西北有兩重背；
units.en: to the northwest two back halos;
units.literal: to the northwest were two back halos;

units.zh: 東北、西北有白氣，并有兩珥；
units.en: northeast and northwest showed white vapor, with two mock suns as well;
units.literal: to the northeast and northwest was white vapor, and also two mock-suns;

units.zh: 中間有一白氣，東西撗至珥。
units.en: between them a streak of white vapor ran east and west to the mock suns.
units.literal: in the middle was one white vapor stretching east and west to the mock-suns.

units.zh: 十二月乙酉，竟天微有白雲，日暈，東南角不合；
units.en: In the twelfth month, on yiyou day, faint white clouds covered the sky; a solar halo appeared with a gap in the southeast;
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiyou, across the whole sky there were faint white clouds; there was a solar halo, and the southeast corner did not close;

units.zh: 西南、東北有珥；
units.en: southwest and northeast showed mock suns;
units.literal: to the southwest and northeast were mock-suns;

units.zh: 西北有一背，去日一尺。
units.en: to the northwest one back halo a chi from the sun.
units.literal: to the northwest was one back halo, a chi from the sun.

units.zh: 五年正月己亥朔，日有蝕之，從西南角起。
units.en: In the first month of year 5, on the jihai new moon, the sun was eclipsed, the obscuration beginning at the southwest limb.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on the day jihai at new moon, there was a solar eclipse; the bite began at the southwest limb.

units.zh: 占曰「不有崩喪，必有臣亡，天下改服」。
units.en: The omen reads: "If there is no imperial death and mourning, ministers will die and the realm will go into mourning dress."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "Unless there is imperial collapse and mourning, ministers will surely die and the realm will change its garments."

units.zh: 丙午，齊獻武王薨。
units.en: On bingwu day, Prince Xianwu of Qi died.
units.literal: On bingwu, Prince Xianwu of Qi died.

units.zh: 三月辛丑，日暈帀，西北交暈貫日，并有一珥一抱。
units.en: In the third month, on xinchou day, a full solar halo appeared; crossed halos in the northwest crossed the sun, with one mock sun and one embrace-shaped halo as well.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day xinchou, the solar halo encircled fully; a crossed halo in the northwest pierced the sun, and there were also one mock-sun and one embrace.

units.zh: 六年七月庚寅朔，日有蝕之，虧從西北角起。
units.en: In the seventh month of year 6, on the gengyin new moon, the sun was eclipsed, and the bite began at the northwest limb.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, on the first day gengyin, there was a solar eclipse, and the bite began at the northwest limb.

units.zh: 校勘記
units.en: Collation Notes
units.literal: Collation notes

units.zh: 高祖延興元年十二月癸卯日有蝕之 按是年十二月乙酋朔，癸卯是十九日，不應有日蝕。
units.en: The entry "In the twelfth month of Yanxing 1, on guimao day, the sun was eclipsed" is erroneous: that year's twelfth month began on yiyou, and guimao is the nineteenth day—no eclipse should occur then.
units.literal: "In the twelfth month of the first year of Yanxing under Emperor Gaozu, on the day guimao, there was a solar eclipse." Examining that year: the twelfth month began on yiyou; guimao is the nineteenth day, and there should not have been a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年十二月癸卯朔日有蝕之四年正月癸酋朔日有蝕之 按無連續兩月日蝕之理，必有誤。
units.en: The entries for a guimao-new-moon eclipse in the twelfth month of year 3 and a guiyou-new-moon eclipse in the first month of year 4 cannot both be right—two eclipses in consecutive months is impossible, and the text must be corrupt.
units.literal: "In the twelfth month of the third year, on the guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse; in the first month of the fourth year, on the guiyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse." Examining the text: there is no reason for solar eclipses in two successive months; there must be an error.

units.zh: 二月乙酋晦日有蝕之 按太和二年二月己卯朔，乙酋乃七日，晦日值丁未。
units.en: The entry "In the second month, on the last day yiyou, the sun was eclipsed" is wrong: in Taihe 2 the second month began on jimao, yiyou is only the seventh day, and the month's last day should be dingwei.
units.literal: "In the second month, on the last day yiyou, there was a solar eclipse." Examining: in the second month of the second year of Taihe the new moon was jimao; yiyou is the seventh day, and the last day of the month should be dingwei.

units.zh: 必有誤。
units.en: The text must be corrupt.
units.literal: There must be an error.

units.zh: 延昌二年二月庚辰 諸本「二月」作「正月」。
units.en: For Yanchang 2, second month, gengchen: all editions read "first month" instead of "second month."
units.literal: Yanchang 2, second month, gengchen: in all editions "second month" reads "first month."

units.zh: 按卷八世宗紀，事在是年二月庚辰。
units.en: Fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Emperor Xuanwu, places the event on gengchen in the second month of that year.
units.literal: Examining fascicle 8, Basic Annals of Shizong, the event is on gengchen in the second month of that year.

units.zh: 是年正月丙戊朔，無庚辰，二月丙辰朔，庚辰乃二十五日。
units.en: That year the first month began on bingxu, so there is no gengchen in the first month; the second month began on bingchen, and gengchen is the twenty-fifth day.
units.literal: That year the first month began on bingxu; there is no gengchen. The second month began on bingchen; gengchen is the twenty-fifth day.

units.zh: 這裏「正月」乃「二月」之訛。
units.en: Here "first month" is a scribal error for "second month."
units.literal: Here "first month" is a corruption for "second month."

units.zh: 今據紀改。
units.en: The text is corrected here according to the annals.
units.literal: Now corrected according to the annals.

units.zh: 十一月乙酉 按卷九肅宗紀，事在神龜二年十一月乙酋。
units.en: Eleventh month, yiyou: fascicle 9, Basic Annals of Emperor Xiaoming, places the event in the eleventh month of Shengui 2, on yiyou day.
units.literal: Eleventh month, yiyou: examining fascicle 9, Basic Annals of Suzong, the event is in the eleventh month of the second year of Shengui, on yiyou.

units.zh: 這裏「十一月」上脫「二年」二字。
units.en: Here the words "second year" have dropped out before "eleventh month."
units.literal: Here above "eleventh month" the two characters "second year" have dropped out.

units.zh: 三年九月己卯 諸本「三年」作「二年」。
units.en: Third year, ninth month, jimao: all editions read "second year" instead of "third year."
units.literal: Third year, ninth month, jimao: in all editions "third year" reads "second year."

units.zh: 按卷九肅宗紀，事在孝昌三年九月辛卯，梁書卷五武帝紀三，在梁大通元年
units.en: Fascicle 9, Basic Annals of Emperor Xiaoming, places the event in the ninth month of Xiaochang 3, on xinmao day; the Book of Liang, fascicle 5, Basic Annals of Emperor Wu 3, places it in Liang Datong 1
units.literal: Examining fascicle 9, Basic Annals of Suzong, the event is in the ninth month of Xiaochang 3, on xinmao; Liang shu, fascicle 5, Basic Annals of Emperor Wu 3, places it in the first year of Datong of Liang

units.zh: 〈即魏孝昌三年〉
units.en: 〈that is, Wei Xiaochang 3〉
units.literal: 〈that is, the third year of Xiaochang of Wei〉

units.zh: 十月。
units.en: the tenth month.
units.literal: the tenth month.

units.zh: 記月不同，當是各據奏報，至元慶和降梁，必在孝昌三年無疑。
units.en: The months differ because each source followed its own report; Yuan Qinghe's surrender to Liang certainly occurred in Xiaochang 3.
units.literal: The months recorded differ; each source must have followed its own memorial report. As for Yuan Qinghe's surrender to Liang, it was certainly in the third year of Xiaochang without doubt.

units.zh: 這裏「二」字乃「三」之訛。
units.en: Here "two" is a scribal error for "three."
units.literal: Here the character "two" is a corruption for "three."

units.zh: 今據紀改。
units.en: The text is corrected here according to the annals.
units.literal: Now corrected according to the annals.

units.zh: 是年九月有「己卯」，無「辛卯」，則是紀誤。
units.en: That year's ninth month has "jimao" but no "xinmao" day, so the annals are wrong.
units.literal: That year in the ninth month there is "jimao" but not "xinmao"; thus the annals are in error.
